title: Dual-functional Ni and Co oxide-doped carbon nanocomposite: an effective catalyst for electrochemical water splitting and CO2 utilization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32667-32678
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04999G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Misbah Zia, Zahoor Ahmad, Khurram S. Munawar, Zafar A. K. Khattak, Hamid Raza, Hira Idrees, Hussain A. Younus, Muhammad Ashraf Shaheen, Nazir Ahmad
An MOF-derived NiOx/CoyOz-doped carbon (NCC) nanocomposite is synthesized and effectively used as a multifunctional and robust catalyst. Precious cyclic carbonates and green H2 are produced via small-molecule activation methodologies.
